misc: Known for deliberating his next shot for a long time, leading to somewhat slow play
biography: Panu represents a wonderfully deliberate presence within the storied history of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Koto Golf to the esteemed pair competition across three distinct editions. Characterized by a meticulously methodical temperament on the links, this thoughtful competitor is widely legendary among his peers for spending an extraordinarily long time deliberating every single stroke, a patient approach that often results in somewhat unhurried play but consistently leaves his opponents admiring his exhaustive tactical calculations.

Although Panu has officially concluded his active chapters within the tournament and is now considered retired from further Hector engagements, his legacy remains firmly secured in the tournament archives. During his time in the field, he tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on one memorable occasion, triumphantly capturing the prized team silverware. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy remained outside his personal collection across his three tournament appearances, his dignified presence and unwavering commitment to analytical precision left an enduring impression on everyone fortunate enough to share the fairways with him.
